args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api (v2.3.1) began failing health checks following the latest production deploy. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production. Rollback verified as rolled out in all regions. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure still under investigation.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Rollback**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1, which was failing health checks. I rolled back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent version healthy in production, across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback was verified as rolled out.
2. **Verification**: Service status confirms checkout-api is now **healthy** on v2.3.0 in all regions, with an error rate of 0.002.
3. **Incident**: Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** describing the v2.3.1 health-check failures and the rollback to v2.3.0, with the on-call engineer paged.

Note: the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is still under investigation — the incident captures that as a follow-up for the on-call engineer.
